name: Verify Arcadians blog publication
prompt:

Quiet blogworthiness record: before finishing, record Blogworthiness: PASS or FAIL with a short evidence-based reason and source evidence in the existing report or final handoff. For PASS also record the reader-interest angle, duplicate check and next action. Do not send or surface a standalone completion-check reminder.

Search exclusions and process ownership — 2 November 2026: Before local discovery, read the current 'Search narrowly and exclude generated storage' section in the shared AGENTS.md and honour the owning root's .rgignore. Put explicit exclusions after inclusion globs. Retain session_id/exit_code; poll a yielded search or cancel its actual owned process/tree and verify exit. Do not leave discovery running after moving on. Apply at the next safe step without restarting or interrupting existing productive work. Record the actual scope/exclusions used in the normal private run receipt; a saved rule alone is not adoption evidence.

Blogworthiness completion check: assess this verification run and record Blogworthiness: PASS or FAIL with a short evidence-based reason and source evidence in the existing handoff; do not create another article about the verification itself. Prefer a sufficient connector/API/CLI when it is more reliable; browser access does not add authority for sends, publication, account changes, spending, rights commitments or sensitive disclosure.
